# QR Code Studio

> Free multilingual QR code generator and QR designer available at https://qrcode.imoein.com/

QR Code Studio is a browser-based tool for creating static QR codes. It supports websites, phone numbers, email addresses, physical locations, social profiles, vCard contact cards, plain text, and mixed custom information.

Key capabilities:
- Generate QR codes locally in the browser.
- Customize module shapes, finder patterns, colors, gradients, quiet zone, and center logo.
- Export QR codes as SVG or PNG.
- Use the interface in English, Finnish, Persian, Arabic, Russian, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, German, Spanish, and French.
- No account is required to create a QR code.

Canonical URL: https://qrcode.imoein.com/
Creator: https://imoein.com/
